name: Generalitat de Catalunya
body: DMARC rejects spoofed mail, HSTS runs a year, and every image on the home page has alt text. But robots.txt opens with Disallow: / for any crawler it does not name, so bots like OAI-SearchBot stay out.
lesson: Name the search and AI answer crawlers you want in robots.txt, so citations can point back to you.
summary: web.gencat.cat scores 84 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 18 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 11 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 11 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search) by Disallow: /, ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, Claude-SearchBot (Claude search) by Disallow: /, Claude-User (Claude, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /,…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 53 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:description, og:image, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 5 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: 1 page has no meta description
fix.evidence: /ca/inici. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No llms.txt was found
fix.evidence: /llms.txt returned 404. It is a proposed convention that some AI tools read to find the pages that matter.
fix.fix: Publish /llms.txt. The fix kit has a draft built from this review.

works.title: Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
The start page sets a mobile viewport
The start page reads well without JavaScript
